title: `rcf define blueprint companions` verb: three sub-verbs (print resolution, set pin, unset pin) with --json on all three
asA: operator inspecting or pinning companion suggestions on an applied service blueprint outside the apply flow
iWant: a `rcf define blueprint companions <slug>` sub-verb that prints the resolved companion set for one applied service blueprint, `rcf define blueprint companions set <role> <slug>` that writes a project-level pin to rcf/companions.json, and `rcf define blueprint companions unset <role>` that removes a pin
soThat: I can read the current resolution without re-applying, pin a decision the operator makes outside the apply, and lift a pin cleanly

acceptanceCriteria.description: `rcf define blueprint companions <slug>` (three positionals: `blueprint`, `companions`, `<slug>`) with `<slug>` naming an applied service blueprint that declares `suggestedCompanions[]` prints on stdout: header `<slug> suggests companions:` and one line per role in the shape `  <role>          -> <resolved-provider> (<origin-note>)`, where the origin note reads `already applied` / `pinned via rcf/companions.json` / `registered library '<prefix>' (overrides shelf provider <shelf-slug>)` / `shelf fallback (no registered library provides this role)`. Exit 0. Refuses with exit 2 when `<slug>` names no applied blueprint or the applied blueprint declares no `suggestedCompanions[]`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with application-api-rest v2.1.0 applied and observability-logging applied
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs `rcf define blueprint companions application-api-rest`
acceptanceCriteria.then: stdout carries the header and one line per role with `already applied` on `logging` and `shelf fallback` (or similar) on `errorHandling`; a slug that is not applied refuses exit 2

acceptanceCriteria.description: `rcf define blueprint companions set <role> <slug>` writes `rcf/companions.json` under `roles.<role>.provider` with `pinnedAt` ISO-8601 (or updates it if present); refuses exit 2 when `<slug>` names no blueprint or the named blueprint does not declare `providesRoles` containing `<role>`. `rcf define blueprint companions unset <role>` removes the `roles.<role>` entry (leaves the rest of the file intact); refuses exit 2 when no pin exists for `<role>`. Both sub-verbs honour `--json` (emit `{ok: true, role, provider, pinnedAt}` on success; `{ok: false, error: {...}}` on refusal).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with no existing pin
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs `rcf define blueprint companions set logging observability-logging`, then `rcf define blueprint companions unset logging`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the first run writes companions.json with the pin (exit 0); the second run removes the pin and prints `[blueprint] companion pin for role 'logging' removed` on stdout (exit 0); an unset on a role without a pin refuses exit 2

acceptanceCriteria.description: `--json` on `rcf define blueprint companions <slug>` emits a machine-readable object: `{slug, suggestions: [{role, provider, origin, notes}]}`, exit 0. The suggestions array preserves the order of the applied blueprint's `suggestedCompanions[]`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a fixture project with application-api-rest applied and both companions applied
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator runs `rcf define blueprint companions application-api-rest --json`
acceptanceCriteria.then: stdout carries a JSON object of the shape above and jq queries against it return the resolved provider per role
